qualification: Synchronous font-refresh guard parent reuse only; root-size early rejection stays before parent lookup. Candidate and retained per-property policies pass all 50 functions in ordinary GC, no GC, poisoned preallocation and address/undefined sanitizers. The initial mutation fixture incorrectly assumed canvastext and black had identical typed values; its rejection is retained, and the final test clones the exact child value into a distinct parent box before mutating it. No parent survives the guard call. Component setup and one warm call remain outside 3,000-call counters; four alternating samples per variant preserve boolean checksums and early-rejection cases. No component-to-page extrapolation.
